code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7,5))
# 45 cm cube outline
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0,0),45,45, fill=False, linewidth=2, label='45cm cube'))
# post below (outside allowed)
ax.plot([22.5,22.5],[0,-8],'k-',linewidth=4)
ax.text(22.5,-6,'post (outside allowed)', ha='center', fontsize=8)
# nacelle body
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((14,20),14,6, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(21,23,'nacelle', ha='center', fontsize=8)
# hub + nose
ax.plot([14,10],[23,23],'k-',linewidth=3)
ax.plot([10,10],[13,33], 'k-', linewidth=2)
ax.text(8,30,'rotor disc 40cm', rotation=90, fontsize=8)
# blade sweep circle tips
ax.plot([10,10],[3,43],'k--',linewidth=1)
ax.text(4,23,'clearance to cube', fontsize=7)
ax.annotate('', xy=(0.5,23), xytext=(8,23), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->'))
ax.text(2,25,'2.5cm', fontsize=8)
# dimensions
ax.set_xlim(-2,48); ax.set_ylim(-10,48); ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.set_xlabel('cm'); ax.set_title('Side view: rotor + nacelle inside 45cm cube on post')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
